answer.text:
Gross profit margin = Gross profit ÷ Net sales × 100  
= $494.777 million ÷ $1,409.281 million × 100  
= **35.1%** (rounded to one decimal place).

The filing also reports a 35.1% margin. *(Accession 0001739566-25-000053, Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, chunk 2.)*
